legend.description: Show HTML legend below chart with series labels and colors.

width.description: Width of the chart in pixels. Default: 480.

height.description: Height of the chart in pixels. Default: 320.

fixedAspectRatioScaling.description: Enable fixed aspect ratio scaling mode. When true, width/height properties define the aspect ratio (not actual pixels). The component fills 100% of parent width and calculates height from aspect ratio. When false...

scaleReferenceSize.description: Reference size for external scales when using fixedAspectRatioScaling. This value is passed down to external scales to determine their 1:1 Figma design size. At this reference size, scales render at native size;...

xAxisType.description: X-axis mode: 'category' for labeled, evenly spaced data points; 'time' for time-based data positioned proportionally; 'number' for plain numeric x-values.

yAxisPosition.description: Single y-axis position ('left' or 'right'). For multiple y-axes, use yAxes instead.

showGridX.description: Show vertical grid lines (x-axis). Default: false. Available when showGrid==true.

showGridY.description: Show horizontal grid lines (y-axis). Default: false. Available when showGrid==true.

showTickMarks.description: Show axis tick marks and labels.

rangeLabels.description: Labels kept below the 192px threshold, where the axis labels are otherwise hidden: 'y' draws min, max and (inside the range) 0 in a gutter on the y-axis side; 'x' draws the first and last x value in a bottom gutter;...

showPoints.description: Show point markers on data points. Default: false.

timeDisplay.description: Time axis label format: 'date' (full date/time) or 'minutes' (relative). Available when xAxisType==time.

xTicksLimit.description: Max number of x-axis ticks/grid lines. Useful for matching external axes.

xStepSize.description: Force x-axis tick interval. Useful for matching external axes.

yTicksLimit.description: Max number of y-axis ticks/grid lines. Useful for matching external axes.

yStepSize.description: Force y-axis tick interval. Useful for matching external axes.

priority.description: Color priority: enhanced uses blue palette instead of default gray.

data.description: A single series, one object per point: `value`, and `label` (a category axis) or `x` (a time axis in epoch milliseconds or an ISO string, or a number axis).
Numbers, or `{x, y}` objects on a time or number axis.

datasets.description: Several series, one object each: `label` and `data` (numbers, or `{x, y}` points on a time or number axis). When the list is not empty it replaces `data`.

labels.description: The category labels shared by the objects of `datasets`, in order.

colors.description: Colours of the series or segments in order, as CSS colour strings. Empty uses the palette of the scheme.

yAxes.description: The value axes, one object each: `id` (named by a series' `yAxisID`), `position`, `min`, `max` and `grid`. Empty draws the one default axis.

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
